name: Passive ER Inclinometer Check
description: Passive ER at 90 deg abduction with a phone inclinometer, weekly during weighted-ball blocks. Proposed rule: if it rises 5 deg or more above the block baseline, stop overload balls until it settles. The 5 deg threshold is a proposal, not validated.

name: Passive ER Inclinometer Check
description: Passive ER at 90 deg abduction with a phone inclinometer, weekly during weighted-ball blocks. Proposed rule: if it rises 5 deg or more above the block baseline, stop overload balls until it settles. The 5 deg threshold is a proposal, not validated.

name: Pelvic Level Leg Lift Test
description: Strap a phone with a level app to the belt, lift the lead foot about 10 cm, read the tilt. Pro median is 7 deg. Retest every 4 weeks. Trend against the athlete's own history.

name: Pelvic Level Leg Lift Test
description: Strap a phone with a level app to the belt, lift the lead foot about 10 cm, read the tilt. Pro median is 7 deg. Retest every 4 weeks. Trend against the athlete's own history.

name: Pelvic Rotation
description: Pelvic rotation mobility screen

name: Pelvic Tilt
description: Pelvic tilt mobility screen

name: Pogo Hop Contact Time Screen
description: Pogo hop ground contact time on 240 fps video. Soft-quality screen, every 4 weeks. Trend against own history only.

name: Pogo Hop Contact Time Screen
description: Pogo hop ground contact time on 240 fps video. Soft-quality screen, every 4 weeks. Trend against own history only.

name: Progressive Muscular Relaxation
description: Tense a muscle group maximally for 10 to 15 s, then relax fully, distal to proximal. Teaches the athlete to recognize and release residual tension.

name: Progressive Muscular Relaxation
description: Tense a muscle group maximally for 10 to 15 s, then relax fully, distal to proximal. Teaches the athlete to recognize and release residual tension.

name: Rower Intervals
description: Anaerobic capacity: 15 to 30 s at 75 to 90%, rest 1:3 to 1:5, 6 to 10 sets. Low-throwing day. 2 times a week in off-season, 1 in season.

name: S Mount Raises
description: Prone/quadruped S-mount shoulder raise

name: S Mount to Half Kneel w/ Single Arm Press
description: Transition drill into half-kneeling single arm press

name: Seated Trunk Rotation
description: Seated trunk rotation mobility screen

name: Side Bends w/ Overhead Reach
description: Warm-up rotational side bend holding light DB

name: Single Leg Balance
description: Single leg balance stability screen

name: Single Leg Stance Eyes Closed
description: Target 30 s per side. Soft-quality screen, every 4 weeks, non-fatiguing. No published norms, trend against the athlete's own history only.

name: Single Leg Stance Eyes Closed
description: Target 30 s per side. Soft-quality screen, every 4 weeks, non-fatiguing. No published norms, trend against the athlete's own history only.

name: Systematic Desensitization
description: Build a hierarchy of throwing scenarios from catch to flat ground to mound to game. Pair each with diaphragmatic breathing and progressive muscular relaxation before progressing. Return-to-throw tool.

name: Systematic Desensitization
description: Build a hierarchy of throwing scenarios from catch to flat ground to mound to game. Pair each with diaphragmatic breathing and progressive muscular relaxation before progressing. Return-to-throw tool.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotation
description: Improve thoracic rotation in quadruped seated or lying positions.

name: Toe Touch
description: Toe touch mobility screen

name: Toe Touch to Extension
description: Standing toe touch into overhead extension

name: Torso Rotation
description: Torso rotation mobility screen

name: Wide Stance Rotations
description: Wide stance trunk rotation warm-up

name: Wrist Flex/Ext
description: Wrist flexion/extension mobility screen

name: Wrist Hinge
description: Wrist hinge mobility screen

name: Zone 2 Bike
description: Conversational pace, 20 to 45 min, 2 to 3 times a week on low-CNS days. Minimum effective dose. Aerobic recovery, never a replacement for power work.

name: Zone 2 Row
description: Conversational pace, 20 to 45 min, 2 to 3 times a week on low-CNS days. Minimum effective dose.

name: Zone 2 Run
description: Conversational pace, 20 to 45 min, 2 to 3 times a week on low-CNS days. Replaces the 20 minute run tag, which is Moderate CNS.

name: 10-Yard Sprint
description: Phosphagen. Max effort, 5 to 10 s or less of work, 5 to 6 reps, full rest of 2 to 5 min. Cutting rest turns it into glycolytic work. Starts relaxed, not pre-tensed.

name: 10-Yard Sprint
description: 10-yard sprint for acceleration speed

name: 20-Yard Sprint
description: Phosphagen. Max effort, 5 to 6 reps, full rest of 2 to 5 min. Cutting rest turns it into glycolytic work.

name: 20-Yard Sprint
description: 20 yard acceleration sprint

name: 30-Yard Sprint
description: Phosphagen. Max effort, 5 to 6 reps, full rest of 2 to 5 min. Cutting rest turns it into glycolytic work.

name: Altitude Landing
description: Gate G3. Land and stick, no rebound, start 12 in. Advance after 3 sessions with quiet landing on video and no valgus. Counts under the KEAT cap of 40 contacts.

name: Band Overhead Press for Speed
description: Band anchored underfoot, press overhead as fast as possible against the band tension.

name: Band-Resisted Squat Jump
description: Band anchored underfoot and over the shoulders, squat jump against the added band tension.

name: Broad Jump
description: Horizontal plyometric training explosive hip extension.

name: Calf Jumps
description: Repeated calf jumps, interval based

name: DB Jump Shrug
description: Dumbbells at the sides, hinge and explosively triple-extend into a shrug and small jump -- same intent as a clean pull without the catch.

name: DB Push Press
description: Dumbbells at the shoulders, dip and drive with the legs to press overhead with speed.

name: DB Squat Jump
description: Dumbbells at the sides or shoulders, squat to a quarter depth and jump for maximum height.

name: Depth Drop to Box Jump
description: Depth drop into box jump

name: Depth Jump
description: Step off box, land and immediately jump as high as possible.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Anaerobic mode: 15 to 30 s at 75 to 90%, rest 1:3 to 1:5, 6 to 10 sets. Keep efforts under 30 s. Rotate modes to avoid monotony.

name: Landmine Push Jerk
description: Barbell in a landmine attachment at the shoulder, dip and drive through the legs to jerk the bar overhead.

name: Landmine Rotational Press
description: Speed-limited rotational press. 3 to 5 sets of 5 per side. Stop at the first visible slowdown.

name: Lateral Bound
description: Jump from one foot to the other laterally.

name: Lateral Bound to Stick
description: Gate G2. Land in side-on stride position, pelvis slightly open and shoulders closed. 3 sets of 5 per side.

name: Lateral Sled Drag
description: Light, fast lateral push. Short sprints with full rest. Lateral momentum, not a strength stimulus.

name: Lunge Switches
description: Reactive alternating lunge switches

name: Med Ball Overhead Slam
description: Speed-limited. 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 5, full rest. End the set when speed drops. Counts toward plyo contacts, not the throw ledger.

name: Med Ball Rotational Chest Pass
description: Speed-limited. 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 5 per side, full rest. Counts toward plyo contacts, not the throw ledger. Starts from a relaxed position, not pre-tensed.

name: Med Ball Side Slam
description: Speed-limited. 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 5 per side, full rest. Counts toward plyo contacts, not the throw ledger.

name: Overspeed Eccentric Drop
description: Drop from a greater height or with assistance than a standard depth jump, emphasizing the fastest possible eccentric loading rate on landing.

name: Pogo Hops
description: Rapid low-amplitude bilateral hops. Minimal knee bend.

name: Rebound Box Jumps
description: Rebounding box jump starting on the box

name: Sandbag Carry
description: Sandbag carry for grip, core, and total body loaded carry work

name: Single Leg CMJ
description: Both sides, report asymmetry %. 3 sets of 3 per side, full rest. Unilateral power test and drill. Single-leg plyo, gate G2.

name: Skater Jump
description: Continuous lateral bounds with brief hold on each landing.

name: Sled Push
description: Phosphagen mode: 5 to 10 s max, rest 2 to 5 min, 5 to 6 sets. Anaerobic mode: 15 to 30 s at 75 to 90%, rest 1:3 to 1:5, 6 to 10 sets. Rotate modes to avoid monotony.

name: Sled Push
description: Sled push for lower body power and conditioning

name: Split Stance Altitude Landing
description: Gate G3. Land in split stance and stick, start 6 to 12 in, progress to land-and-extend. Lead-leg braking. Video required. Counts under the KEAT cap of 40 contacts.

name: Step Behind Stride Med Ball Toss
description: 2 to 3 kg ball, 3 sets of 5. Stop at the first slowdown. Momentum flowing into rotation.

name: Step In Rotational Med Ball Throw
description: Step in from a stride stance. 3 to 4 kg for force, 1 to 2 kg for speed. 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 5 per side. Stop before failure. Trunk rotation power is the strongest velocity predictor in the research.

name: Trap Bar Jump
description: Gate G1. Added load 20 to 40% of bodyweight, jump height must stay within 10% of unloaded. 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 5, speed-limited, full rest. Not stacked with another high-CNS day.

name: Triple Broad Jump
description: Three consecutive broad jumps for maximum distance.

name: Weighted Broad Jump
description: Hold light dumbbells at the sides, broad jump for maximum distance, land under control.

name: Weighted Lateral Bound
description: Hold a light dumbbell or vest load, bound laterally from one foot to the other, sticking each landing.

name: 4 oz Ball Throw
description: Underload ball, 4 oz only. Gate T2, velocity block only, never in season. Mound or on-line only, never run-and-gun flat ground. Two modified throws for every one standard throw and end every set with the 5 oz ball. Stop at a 4% velocity drop. Ledger 1.1.

name: 4 oz Ball Throw
description: Underload ball, 4 oz only. Gate T2, velocity block only, never in season. Mound or on-line only, never run-and-gun flat ground. Two modified throws for every one standard throw and end every set with the 5 oz ball. Stop at a 4% velocity drop. Ledger 1.1.

name: 6 oz Ball Throw
description: Overload ball, 6 oz only. Gate T2, velocity block only, never in season. Mound or on-line only. Two modified throws for every one standard throw, finish every set with 5 oz. Check passive ER weekly. Stop at a 4% velocity drop. Ledger 1.1.

name: 6 oz Ball Throw
description: Overload ball, 6 oz only. Gate T2, velocity block only, never in season. Mound or on-line only. Two modified throws for every one standard throw, finish every set with 5 oz. Check passive ER weekly. Stop at a 4% velocity drop. Ledger 1.1.

name: Anterior Hop Throw
description: Hop forward off the pivot foot, land, and throw immediately on landing -- same intent as Forward Hop Throw with the anterior direction named explicitly.

name: Bullpen
description: Pitching off a mound at competitive intensity in a practice setting.

name: Called Target Bullpen
description: Constraint work for command, 5 to 10% of throwing volume. Three targets, catcher calls each pitch at random, chart misses on a grid. Preseason and in season. No cueing.

name: Called Target Bullpen
description: Constraint work for command, 5 to 10% of throwing volume. Three targets, catcher calls each pitch at random, chart misses on a grid. Preseason and in season. No cueing.

name: Catch Play
description: Easy, controlled catch-play throwing at conversational intensity -- the lowest-intent entry in live throwing.

name: Catcher Throw Down
description: Catcher's throw to a base from a receiving position, emphasizing rapid transfer out of the glove.

name: Competition
description: Live game pitching.

name: Double Hop Throw
description: Two consecutive hops pivot foot then lead foot throw immediately.

name: Double Play Feed
description: Quick-transfer feed to a pivot player, emphasizing fast exchange and release over full-effort velocity.

name: Drop Step Throw
description: Drop step to open the hips and gain ground before throwing, simulating an outfield or infield redirect.

name: Flat Ground
description: Pitching off flat ground rather than a mound, building toward full mound intensity.

name: Flecha Javelin Throw
description: Phase 3 Adapt implement, a ball-tipped training dart. Foam javelin or football if no Flecha. 10 to 20 throws at I3 with a full approach allowed. Counts in the throw ledger at 0.8. Prep periods only.

name: Flecha Javelin Throw
description: Phase 3 Adapt implement, a ball-tipped training dart. Foam javelin or football if no Flecha. 10 to 20 throws at I3 with a full approach allowed. Counts in the throw ledger at 0.8. Prep periods only.

name: Football Throw
description: Throw a football, adapting grip and release timing to a different implement shape and weight distribution.

name: Forward Hop Throw
description: Hop forward on pivot foot, land, immediately throw upon landing.

name: Frisbee Throw
description: Throw a flying disc, adapting release and wrist action to a completely different flight mechanism.

name: Grab and Go
description: Ball handed off or picked up in motion, then thrown immediately with no set position beforehand.

name: High Intent Long Toss
description: I4 long toss, auto-regulated. One per week in off-season on a day that is already high-CNS, as the build-up into weighted work. Coming in: hard on-line line drives. Max-distance throws carry the highest torque, use sparingly. 48 h before the next high-CNS exposure.

name: High Intent Long Toss
description: I4 long toss, auto-regulated. One per week in off-season on a day that is already high-CNS, as the build-up into weighted work. Coming in: hard on-line line drives. Max-distance throws carry the highest torque, use sparingly. 48 h before the next high-CNS exposure.

name: Hover Throw
description: Balance on pivot foot with lead leg lifted. Hold 1-2 seconds then throw.

name: Miss Ellipse Test
description: 15 pitches to one target, photograph the miss pattern on a gridded net. Track the long axis (timing) and short axis (position). Counts as throws. Retest each block.

name: Miss Ellipse Test
description: 15 pitches to one target, photograph the miss pattern on a gridded net. Track the long axis (timing) and short axis (position). Counts as throws. Retest each block.

name: Moderate Long Toss
description: I3 long toss, auto-regulated and distance never prescribed. Stop extending when mechanics, accuracy or comfort change. Low CNS. Counts as throws beyond warm-up catch distance.

name: Moderate Long Toss
description: I3 long toss, auto-regulated and distance never prescribed. Stop extending when mechanics, accuracy or comfort change. Low CNS. Counts as throws beyond warm-up catch distance.

name: On-Line Flat Ground
description: Hard on-line throws, the arm conditioning tool. I3 in general prep with distance rising before intensity. I4 to I5 only in the velocity block and preseason. Start every ramp-up on flat ground, not the mound.

name: On-Line Flat Ground
description: Hard on-line throws, the arm conditioning tool. I3 in general prep with distance rising before intensity. I4 to I5 only in the velocity block and preseason. Start every ramp-up on flat ground, not the mound.

name: One Knee Throw
description: Throwing-side knee down, glove-side foot forward.

name: Posterior Hop Throw
description: Hop backward off the pivot foot, land, and throw immediately on landing, reversing the direction of Anterior Hop Throw.

name: Pulldown
description: Gate T3, off-season or velocity block only. Max 1 session per 14 days, 8 to 12 max-effort throws after a full long toss build-up. Stop at a 4% velocity drop, never within 48 h of another high-CNS exposure, never the primary velocity tool. Recheck shoulder ER within 72 h.

name: Pulldown
description: Gate T3, off-season or velocity block only. Max 1 session per 14 days, 8 to 12 max-effort throws after a full long toss build-up. Stop at a 4% velocity drop, never within 48 h of another high-CNS exposure, never the primary velocity tool. Recheck shoulder ER within 72 h.

name: Rear foot elevated ground throw
description: rear foot slightly elevated

name: Rocker Drill
description: Split stance. Rock weight back to front rhythmically.

name: Seated Throw
description: Seated on the ground, legs extended or crossed, throw using only trunk rotation and arm action with the lower half fully removed.

name: Shuffle Throw
description: Lateral shuffle steps into the throw, simulating fielding-to-throw footwork.

name: Softball Throw
description: Throw a softball, adapting grip to a larger-circumference implement.

name: Split Stance Throw
description: Lead foot already planted at stride width. Throw from fixed position.

name: Toss Up Throw
description: Toss ball slightly upward and catch in throwing hand as arm begins action.

name: Toss Up with Leg Lift
description: Toss the ball slightly upward while lifting the lead knee, catching it in the throwing hand as the leg comes down and the arm begins its action.

name: Turbo Javelin Throw
description: Throw a turbo javelin, adapting to its long lever and tail-driven flight for release-point feel.

name: Two Knee Throw
description: Kneel on both knees. Throw using only trunk rotation and arm action.

name: Two-Knee Rocker Drill
description: Kneeling on both knees, rock weight back to front rhythmically before throwing -- combines the Two Knee Throw's constrained base with the Rocker Drill's timing cue.

name: Variable Condition Flat Ground
description: Change stride length or footing slightly each set while the target stays the same. Constraint work, 5 to 10% of throwing volume. Trains release timing under varied conditions.

name: Variable Condition Flat Ground
description: Change stride length or footing slightly each set while the target stays the same. Constraint work, 5 to 10% of throwing volume. Trains release timing under varied conditions.

name: Walk Away Throw
description: Walk away from target, pivot and throw in one fluid motion.

name: Walking Windup
description: Walk into a full windup and throw without stopping, blending gait with the delivery.
